Officials say the project will improve fish movement, restore native vegetation and remove invasive aquatic plants.

items.title: ‘Psychiatrist said optimism is your problem’: Anupam Kher on battle with manic depression
items.body: <![CDATA[Anupam Kher has recalled being diagnosed with manic depression around 10-12 years ago after prolonged sleepless nights, despite enjoying professional success. items.body: <![CDATA[Renowned filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma recently shared a picture with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga. items.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' BO Day 50 [LIVE]: Neem Kaorli Baba biopic sets sight on Rs 290 crore India net mark
items.body: <![CDATA['Hanuman Ansh' has reached the significant milestone of Day 50 in theatres, with its India net collection now standing at Rs. 288.55 crore. Vishal Chaturvedi's spiritual biopic on Neem Karoli Baba, led by Shobhinaw Satyaa, has completed a full 50 days on the big screen, a rare feat for a film that opened to a near-invisible start, with its worldwide gross now past Rs. 377 crore. Reaching a 50-day theatrical run is itself a notable achievement in today's fast-churning box office landscape, and 'Hanuman Ansh' has managed it while still adding fresh crores to its tally rather than running purely on nostalgia. Day 50 numbers are still coming in through the day, with the final figure to follow once all shows have concluded.

Featuring Keerthy Suresh, the film draws inspiration from events of the 1990s. He noted how the journey of creating this film has transformed him both personally and artistically. Subbaraj believes strongly in the audience's engagement and urges fans to steer clear of spoilers.

items.body: <![CDATA[Arjun Kapoor has revived 'Main Hoon Na' sequel speculation after sharing his desire for a sequel to Farah Khan’s 2004 blockbuster. Farah responded to his Instagram Story with a playful message echoing one of her most famous film dialogues, prompting renewed curiosity among fans. In a related note, 'Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar' experienced a downturn, earning Rs 82 lakhs on Day 12. Both films face significant challenges in improving their box office performance as industry experts forecast tough times ahead.

items.title: 'Mandaadi' BO day 13 vs 'Sardar 2'
items.body: <![CDATA[On Day 13, Soori's film 'Mandaadi' earned Rs 1.90 crores, bringing its total gross collection to Rs 93.40 crores. The film showed a decline in earnings compared to the previous day but still performed well overall. Its first week collection was Rs 57.30 crores, with stronger weekend numbers contributing to the totals. In contrast, Karthi's 'Sardar 2' has reported low collections, struggling to compete against 'Mandaadi'.

items.title: Mammootty, Dhanush share National Award posts
items.body: <![CDATA[In a grand ceremony celebrating excellence in cinema, Mammootty won the Best Actor award for his outstanding role in 'Bramayugam' at the 72nd National Film Awards. Dhanush's film 'Raayan' was recognized as the Best Tamil Film, and he received a Special Mention. Both actors, donned in traditional attire, were honored by President Droupadi Murmu.

items.title: Govinda SPOTTED with Komal Rani, amid row with wife
items.body: <![CDATA[Bollywood actor Govinda visited the Lalbaugcha Raja in Mumbai for Ganpati blessings with co-star Komal Rani. They participated in prayers, joining fellow devotees at the pandal. Recently, rumors about their relationship have emerged, leading to allegations from Govinda's wife, Sunita Ahuja. The actor emphasized his hopes for a successful comeback film, 'Roopa', aimed at younger audiences. He believes this project may inspire and rekindle dreams for many viewers.

items.title: In 2011, Johnny Galecki bought a ranch for $1.2 million; he listed it for $825,000 years later
items.body: <![CDATA[In 2011, Johnny Galecki made a significant investment of USD 1.5 million in a California ranch enriched with various modern amenities. Sadly, the property faced a tragic turnaround in 2017 when wildfires ravaged the area, leading to the destruction of his main house and others nearby. As a result, he opted to sell the ranch for USD 825,000, a considerable loss.

items.title: Presley Gerber’s ex-girlfriend Lexi Wood pays her respects to 27-year-old model
items.body: <![CDATA[In a heartbreaking development, Presley Gerber, son of model Cindy Crawford, has died at the young age of 27 due to an alleged overdose and subsequent cardiac arrest. Lexi Wood, his former girlfriend, expressed her sorrow through social media, sharing memories of their deep bond and praising his compassionate spirit. The loss has deeply impacted his family, especially sister Kaia Gerber, as they grapple with this unexpected tragedy.

items.title: Malayalam actor Vinu Mohan and Vidya divorce
items.body: <![CDATA[Vinu Mohan and Vidya have reportedly divorced after 13 years of marriage, marking the end of their relationship. They had been married since 2013, having met through their connection with the film industry. Vinu has removed pictures of Vidya from his social media account, which has raised speculation among fans. Vidya still retains their pictures on her Instagram, and her account name reflects their previous union.

items.title: Ssunita on divorce rumours, says she doesn't regret marrying Govinda
items.body: <![CDATA[Ssunita Ahuja says she has no regrets marrying Govinda after 40 years, despite divorce rumours and reports linking him to co-star Komal Rani. She called Govinda "very nice" and "very honest." Ssunita earlier reacted sharply to the rumours; Govinda hit back. She later withdrew her divorce case, which his manager addressed.

items.title: Tom Cruise unveils 'Digger' at star‑studded London premiere
items.body: <![CDATA[Tom Cruise premiered his new film 'Digger' in London, showcasing his unique character of oil tycoon Digger Rockwell. The movie explores themes of power and greed, hinting at an impending ecological disaster. Directed by Alejandro G. Inarritu, the film features a careful crafting of its narrative and visuals. Cruise's performance is considered a culmination of his extensive acting experience.

items.title: Dolly Parton’s manager files restraining order against Bryan Seaver
items.body: <![CDATA[In a notable legal dispute, Danny Nozell, who manages Dolly Parton, has taken action against Bryan Seaver by filing a restraining order due to purported threats. Seaver, recently let go after Parton’s passing, insists his communications were misconstrued. The order restricts Seaver from engaging with Dolly's business and connections, as allegations arise over his attempts to intimidate and compromise the Parton legacy. Legal proceedings are still ongoing.

items.title: Bunnie Xo responds to haters about her and Dylan Wolf’s romance
items.body: <![CDATA[Following her divorce from Jelly Roll, Bunnie Xo has embarked on a new romantic journey with 24-year-old Dylan Wolf. This relationship has faced scrutiny from social media users because of the 22-year age difference. Nevertheless, Bunnie has publicly expressed her contentment, claiming that being with Dylan has enabled her to reclaim her happiness and confidence. Additionally, the former couple reportedly continues to pursue their shared IVF and surrogacy goals.

items.title: Allu Arjun congratulates Sukumar on National Award win for ‘Pushpa 2’
items.body: <![CDATA[Allu Arjun congratulated director Sukumar for his achievement at the 72nd National Film Awards. Both won National Awards for their contributions to the 'Pushpa' franchise. The first part of 'Pushpa' showcased Allu Arjun's character rise in the smuggling trade. The sequel further developed his story and achieved significant box office success. Other notable winners at the awards included Yami Gautam and Kartik Aaryan.

items.title: 'Don't Trouble The Trouble' trailer OUT
items.body: <![CDATA[The newly released trailer for 'Don't Trouble The Trouble' showcases Fahadh Faasil as a magician devoid of any real magic. Set to premiere on October 2, 2026, the film features prominent voice-overs from Mohanlal and Kamal Haasan. The plot revolves around Suri, who aids a girl with actual supernatural powers in her quest to locate her parents, leading to unforeseen challenges and adventures.

items.title: Nag Ashwin confirms ‘Kalki 2898 AD Part 2’ regular shoot to begin in October 2026
items.body: <![CDATA[Nag Ashwin has announced that shooting for 'Kalki 2898 AD: Part 2' will commence in October 2026. The director anticipates completing the filming by mid-2027, following the success of the first film. He expressed gratitude for the audience's positive response and enthusiasm for the sequel. 'Kalki 2898 AD' won two National Awards, enhancing the team's motivation for the next installment.
